premarket.market_expectations: Markets face bearish pressure today with US futures sharply lower and the rupee weakening, though domestic institutional flows remain supportive. The negative overnight moves in US indices and rising Treasury yields create headwinds, while oil's retreat offers some relief. With the Nifty previously closing in the bottom third of its range and a negative bias score, caution prevails despite recent three-day gains in domestic markets.
